a.lede: Microsoft is giving its Copilot app another facelift.
a.title: Microsoft's Copilot app adds Office, natural coding and automation

b.lede: After teasing its new Copilot "super app" last month, Microsoft is officially unveiling it today. The redesigned Copilot app bundles three AI capabilities into a single interface of chat, coding, and agents. As part of the launch, Microsoft is also rebranding Scout, the AI personal assistant it unveiled at Build earlier this year, as Autopilot. […]
b.title: Microsoft thinks its new Copilot ‘super app’ will be as influential as Office
